name: Lian Yu Weixie Zhiyu
source: The story takes place in a world where “believing makes it real” — a world where people can immerse themselves in their own delusions, and the collective recognition of the people must also be “real.” It is not that people ‘s consensus conforms to the world, but rather the world changes itself to conform to people’s recognition. In such a world, Yang, the male protagonist who has lost part of his memories, meets a girl named Xiaoyu, who claims to be his childhood friend and girlfriend. Together, they set out on a journey to recover their memories, and along the way, they uncover the truth behind Yang ‘s amnesia.
translation: 故事发生在一个“相信就是真实”的世界——在这里，人们可以沉浸在各自的妄想之中，而众人的共同认知也必定成为“真实”。并不是人们的共识去顺应世界，而是世界会主动改变自身来贴合人们的认知。在这样一个世界里，失去了部分记忆的男主角“阳”，邂逅了一位自称是他青梅竹马兼女友的少女“小雨”。两人结伴踏上了寻回记忆的旅途，并在一路同行的过程中，渐渐揭开了阳失忆背后的真相。
